newsitem.title: UK: British election diary for April 29.
newsitem.headline: British election diary for April 29.

text.p: Here are the principal press conferences and canvassing appearances in the British election campaign for Tuesday, April 29:
Prime Minister John Major stages an 0945 BST press conference at Conservative Central Office in London with Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine and Party Chairman Brian Mawhinney.

Labour Party leader Tony Blair will be joined by finance spokesman Gordon Brown and trade and industry spokeswoman Margaret Beckett for a 1030 BST press conference at Labour's Millbank Tower media centre.
Sir James Goldsmith of the Referendum Party will be hosting a press conference at 1430 BST.
